subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should experimental `claws export` support only healthy exact installed state now, or should it also offer an explicit drift/snapshot mode with a machine-readable drift report?
rationale: This determines the permanent user-facing meaning of export, the expected recovery workflow for partially drifted installations, and whether the new rejection behavior is intentionally restrictive rather than an incidental implementation choice.

options.title: Approve healthy-state-only export
options.body: Keep exact-state rejection as the initial contract, require current-head success and rejection proof, and defer snapshots until their drift-report semantics are designed.

options.title: Require an explicit snapshot mode
options.body: Add a separately named snapshot path that preserves drift evidence and lineage rather than silently treating incomplete state as a normal portable package.

recommendation.title: Approve healthy-state-only export
recommendation.body: Keep exact-state rejection as the initial contract, require current-head success and rejection proof, and defer snapshots until their drift-report semantics are designed.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment articulates the unresolved product boundary in concrete lifecycle and portability terms.
